description: This file defines an interface 'OpenmrsMetadataDAO' for data access operations related to OpenMRS metadata objects. It provides method signatures for retrieving and counting metadata entities, with options for filtering by retirement status and supporting pagination.

classes.name: OpenmrsMetadataDAO
classes.description: A generic interface for CRUD operations on OpenMRS metadata objects, extending common object DAO functionalities. It includes methods for retrieving all metadata, possibly retired, with optional pagination, and counting such objects.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all metadata objects, including optionally retired ones.

methods.name: getAllCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of metadata objects, including optionally retired ones.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of metadata objects, with optional inclusion of retired objects.
